function: Radar target detection (number and delay-Doppler location of targets) from the OTFS demodulated signal with a DNN, p. 1 and p. 3; sensing only, none of the seven areas.
notes: Excluded for function. The learned network (Faster R-CNN with SE and multi-scale fusion, plus an NMS step) only detects radar targets: it outputs the number and location of targets (p. 3) and is scored only by PD and PFA against CA-CFAR, FCN and Faster R-CNN (p. 5). No symbol detection, communication channel estimation, beam, waveform or resource design is learned or evaluated. The paper calls its setting an ISAC system (p. 1: "as an ISAC system, the radar receiver has knowledge of data information"), but the model is one scalar OTFS radar link with no antenna array and no RIS (p. 2, Eq. 5). Borderline: if the reviewer reads OTFS-ISAC target detection as area 4 (OTFS works admit single-antenna links) the work would be included; read as area 5 it would fail the system check.
